approvals.quality_gate: M1 design accepted; implementation and M3 not accepted yet

open_issues.description: Dedicated HTTPS same-origin test data/accounts and actual Cookie/multi-tab tests are not authorized or executed by this implementation.
Full model schema, upstream timestamp semantics, production performance and cancellation/billing acceptance remain P1/M3.

definition_format: Descriptive field types, not JSON Schema or example responses

authentication.session_header: X-Auth-Session optional; if present must match SID, never session guid
authentication.logout: Cookie SID must equal Bearer SID; clears Cookie
authentication.password_change: clears Cookie and invalidates all sessions; old password error 401
authentication.register: 201 without session; trim username 3-20 ASCII alphanumeric underscore hyphen; password 8-20 Unicode characters and server weak-password rules
authentication.sessions: active nonexpired nonrevoked, no pagination, max 100; last_active_at DESC then internal id DESC

rules: 401 meaning depends on endpoint and envelope; never replay auth writes
unknown non-JSON data must not be displayed verbatim
retired phone auth is 410 only at target90abbdc, not old main

sse_rules: error is irreversible terminal; callbacks terminate at most once
EOF without business done is incomplete
cancel does not prove server cancellation or no billing
existing compare compatibility must remain tested
